ownerDecision.decision: The STRATO-internal hand-off from the authenticated submission server (smtp.strato.com) to STRATO's outbound relays (*.smtp.rzone.de) is accepted as provider-internal risk. It never leaves STRATO's own infrastructure; both observable network hops around it are proven TLS1.3 and SPF passes.
ownerDecision.scope: Only the unrecorded hop between two TLS hops whose hosts are inside providerDomains. Every other TR-08 condition (TLS on every recorded hop including the next server hop, SPF pass at the receiving boundary, port reachability never sufficient) is enforced by the evaluator and tests.
ownerDecision.openItem: STRATO has not published a TLS policy for this internal hop; a written STRATO statement would replace this owner decision.
